# dodopayments_meters (Data Source)

Lists meters.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "dodopayments_meters" "example" {
  max_items = 10
}

output "meters" {
  value = data.dodopayments_meters.example.items
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `archived` (Boolean) List archived meters.
- `locale` (String) Shows the translated name, description and unit of the catalog entities in this
locale. The value must be a code from `GET /locales`, for example `fr`.
A field with no translation, an unknown code, or no code shows the base text.

Do not send a text from a localized response back in a create or update request.
The base text then changes to the translated text.
- `max_items` (Number) The maximum number of items to return. The default is 1000.

### Read-Only

- `items` (Attributes List) The meters that the API returned. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--items))

<a id="nestedatt--items"></a>
### Nested Schema for `items`

Read-Only:

- `aggregation` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--items--aggregation))
- `business_id` (String)
- `created_at` (String)
- `description` (String)
- `event_name` (String)
- `filter` (Attributes) A filter structure that combines multiple conditions with logical conjunctions (AND/OR).

Supports up to 3 levels of nesting to create complex filter expressions.
Each filter has a conjunction (and/or) and clauses that can be either direct conditions or nested filters. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--items--filter))
- `id` (String)
- `measurement_unit` (String)
- `name` (String)
- `updated_at` (String)

<a id="nestedatt--items--aggregation"></a>
### Nested Schema for `items.aggregation`

Read-Only:

- `key` (String) Required when type is not COUNT.
- `type` (String) Aggregation type for the meter.


<a id="nestedatt--items--filter"></a>
### Nested Schema for `items.filter`

Read-Only:

- `clauses` (String) Filter clauses - can be direct conditions or nested filters (up to 3 levels deep). A JSON document. Use `jsonencode()` to set it.
- `conjunction` (String) Logical conjunction to apply between clauses (and/or).
